description.en: Audits whether an agent follows AGENTS.md-style rules: 21 predicate types over native DSH events (approvals, sandbox modes, jobs, turns, file writes), a pre-execute approval gate for red lines, per-finding false-positive triage, baseline significance, and rule-authoring advice with one-click fixes.
description.zh: 审计 agent 是否真的遵守 AGENTS.md 式规则：21 类判据基于 DSH 原生事件（审批、沙箱模式、后台任务、轮次、文件写入），红线在执行前弹审批，发现级误报标记，与基线做显著性比较，并对规则本身给出制定建议且支持一键采纳。
